This is negative evidence against rule-based, evidence-driven economic policymaking.","question_ids":["5B.7","5B.4","5B.5"]},{"title":"Egypt IMF reaches agreement on the fourth review of the EFF","publisher":"IMF","date":"2024-12-24","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/12/24/pr24500-egypt-imf-reaches-sla-on-the-fourth-review-on-the-eff","summary":"The IMF still said Egypt needed to accelerate divestment, reduce the state footprint, and improve the business environment. That shows reform was still unfinished by year-end, which weakens any claim of fully corrected policymaking.","question_ids":["5B.7","5B.3","5B.4"]}]}
